Measured results are copied: R06.10, R06.12, R06.13, R06.14, R07.6, R08.10, R08.11, R09.9, R10.1 and R10.2 fail, the rest pass. Invariants hold except I05, which is open and unchanged; I09 passes at 1.8543. Recommend reverting.
